description:
[Stateless sovereign PII scrubber. Pure regex & Luhn/MOD-97 calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Detects and pseudonymizes European personal identifiable information (Codice Fiscale, EU VAT, IBANs, Luhn credit cards, emails, phone numbers, and IPv4/IPv6 addresses) strictly within local memory under GDPR Art. 4(5) and Art. 32.
Usage: Use this tool to sanitize sensitive text, contracts, medical records, or support tickets before forwarding to external LLMs or third-party platforms.
Returns: JSON object with { originalLength: number, sanitizedLength: number, detectedEntityCount: number, detectedEntityTypes: array, entities: array, sanitizedText: string, sovereignAudit: object }.

saltSecret.description: Optional salt for deterministic HMAC hashing

text.description: Raw input text containing potential European PII to inspect and sanitize

name: eu_pii_scrubber_anonymizer
title: EU Sovereign PII Scrubber & Pseudonymizer
